definition: to pass from one side of something to the other
description: Bright blue sea under water. A young woman in a black wetsuit, mask and long black fins swims forward through a clear tunnel that opens in the middle of a huge swirling school of small silver fish. Dolphins and sea lions glide along the edges of the shoal and cross the tunnel near her, trails of bubbles rise towards the surface, and the hull of a small boat floats on the sunlit surface high above. Rays of light shine down through the water.
